# UI Review

Read-only review of the React SPA at `resources/frontend/src/` (React 19 + TS + Vite + Tailwind CSS 4 + TipTap + Zustand, "Editorial Architect" design system). Fast checklist; delegate deep checks to the `react-reviewer` agent. NOT Inertia — routing is `react-router-dom`.

## Arguments
- `$ARGUMENTS` — Optional file path or component name. Omit to review the working diff.

## Design System & Styling

Repo has **no shadcn (`@/components/ui/*`), no `cn()` / `@/lib/utils`, no icon library** — icons are inline SVG; styling is plain Tailwind classes plus the custom design system in `resources/frontend/src/design-system/` (`tokens.css`, `components.css`, `DESIGN_SYSTEM.md`).

1. **Design tokens** — surface tokens (`bg-surface`, `bg-surface-container`, …) + text tokens (`text-on-surface`, `text-on-surface-variant`); never pure `#000`. Brand: `text-primary`/`bg-primary` (`#172a40`), `text-secondary` (`#146a5d`) for success/caret/highlights
2. **No-line rule** — sections via tonal surface shifts, not 1px solid borders
3. **No dark mode** — no `dark:` variants exist; flag any `dark:*` class as an error (theme is the cream/amber "Ink and Paper" palette, not a toggle)
4. **Typography** — `font-serif` (Lora) for headings/body; `font-sans` (DM Sans) + `label-ui` for buttons, nav, labels
5. **Shadows** — ambient only (`0px 4px 20px rgba(28,28,25,0.06)`); no heavy box shadows
6. **Icons** — inline SVG, not runtime-injected; `aria-hidden` or a label as appropriate

## TypeScript

7. No `any` / `@ts-ignore`; type prop shapes; `import type` for type-only imports; types are `type` aliases (no `interface`)

## React & State

8. **Exports** — **named** exports (`export function Editor()`), not default
9. **Zustand** — select via `useStore((s) => s.field)` (not destructure-after-call); `useStore.getState()` in callbacks/effects; reset store in `beforeEach` in tests
10. **API** — use the `api` client from `@/lib/api.ts`; no raw `fetch()` in components
11. **Performance** — `useCallback` for handlers to memoized children; no inline object/style props in loops; virtualize 100+ item lists

## i18n

12. No hardcoded user-facing strings — use `useTranslation()`; add keys to **every** locale (`en.ts`, `es.ts`, `fr.ts`, `de.ts`, `ar.ts`) using `{section}.{descriptor}` dot notation

## Accessibility

13. `aria-label` on icon-only buttons, `alt` on images, labels on form inputs, interactive elements keyboard-reachable with `hover:*`/`focus:*`/`transition-*`

## TipTap (components/editor/ only)

14. Guard `editor.*` with `if (!editor)` / `editor?.isDestroyed` in async paths; persist via `editor.getHTML()` (not `getJSON()`); register extensions once; no runtime `document.createElement('style')` — put styles in `components.css`

## Tests

15. Co-located `.test.tsx`; mock from `@/test` helpers; run `make test-fe` (or `npm --prefix resources/frontend run test`)
